fix_summary: Handle case where file_path has no parent directory (e.g., 'todo.json')
acceptance_criteria_met: TodoStorage.save() works correctly when path is a simple filename like 'todo.json'
No errors when parent directory is the current directory (exists by definition)

implementation_details.approach: Added early return in _ensure_parent_directory when parent is Path('.') (current directory). This prevents unnecessary mkdir call on '.' which would raise FileExistsError.
